name: overlayrag
description: Layered, versioned, governed knowledge for RAG: ordered layers with explicit overrides, tombstones, and reproducible snapshots.

paragraphs: Layered, versioned, signed knowledge for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

overlayrag is a small, database-agnostic library for managing what a RAG system is allowed to know. It is not a vector database or an LLM framework. It sits underneath your retrieval code and answers: which documents are in force right now, who approved them, what changed since last month, and can we prove exactly what an answer was based on.

The main reason is one implementation of the integrity rules. Hashing, canonical JSON, snapshot IDs and signature verification are implemented once, so .NET, Python, TypeScript and C hosts all compute the same digests and enforce the same trust policy. Two implementations of canonical JSON that disagree on one edge case would split a snapshot ID.
